column1: # The toolchain GAIA needs, one tool per row. /setup-gaia, /gaia-init and
# /update-gaia reads the target bundle's copy, so the incoming release sets the
# floor. A tool below its floor stops setup and update alike. Columns,
#   floor     lowest passing version, or - when presence is the whole check
#   upgrade   user (GAIA cannot install it) or gaia (GAIA installs it itself)
# Tab-separated rather than JSON because jq is one of the tools checked.
